cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Fair Exchange
cards.instruction: Price every favor in time, effort, inconvenience, or future obligation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've turned your little timer over too. I'll scrub this pan for six minutes if you spend six minutes ironing my shirts.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's for tea. Six minutes won't shift that cheese.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Tea gets six; dried cheese gets twelve. Twelve minutes of ironing, then.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll soak it overnight. It'll wipe straight out in the morning.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then one shirt for the wiping, and you bring me tea while I do it. Use the timer.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 copies B tea timing as a labor rate; A3 never admits the mistake and doubles the rate; A5 trades the corrected task for a shirt and tea.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4 reduced labor and turns the original tea cue into part payment.
